site_description: Circulab is a map of agroecological resources.

home.hero_title: Collaborative map for agroecology and circularity.
home.hero_description: Participatory mapping platform dedicated to identifying and valuing underutilized or wasted urban resources.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Collaborative mapping for the agroecological transition and circular economy.
about.mission_desc: Map, connect, and energize agroecological resources and circular economy initiatives, promoting community sustainability and resilience.
about.vision_desc: Facilitate the transition to more sustainable territories by making visible the resources and projects that transform our communities.
about.values_desc: Open collaboration, free access to knowledge, environmental regeneration, and local empowerment.
about.how_step1_desc: Locate community gardens, composting initiatives, repair spots, and agroecological markets.
about.how_step2_desc: Add new resources to the map and help keep the information updated for the whole community.
about.how_step3_desc: Connect with local projects, share resources, and strengthen circular economy networks.
about.faq_a1: Circulab is a participatory mapping platform dedicated to identifying and highlighting agroecological resources and circular economy initiatives.
about.faq_q2: How can I add a new resource to the map?
about.faq_a2: You can register your initiative or point of interest by accessing the map section and clicking on "Add resource".
about.faq_a3: Yes, Circulab is a free-access and collaborative initiative for the entire community.
about.cta_desc: Explore the resources available in your region or contact us to learn more.
